_meta.description: Per-officer chat lines, voice, and personality for the Torus Coffee Company Discord bots. Keyed by crew_key (must match crew_map.json 'crew' keys). Used by discord_crew_bot.py and relay_watcher.py.
_meta.how_to_extend: Add new entries under any officer's array. Lines are picked at random by the bot unless a 'context' is specified.
_meta.voice_global: Pirate-meets-coffee-ops. Short, warm, competent. No walls of text.

placeholders.{crew}: Name of the addressed crew member (filled by .format)
placeholders.{channel}: Channel the line is posted to
placeholders.{task}: Task/project subject from the relay payload

captain.personality: Final authority. Speaks plainly, decides fast, expects execution. Used when the bot relays on the Captain's behalf.
greeting: Captain. Status?
Ledgerbane here. Bring me the Torus report.
status_ok: Torus is in order. Well done, all.
status_busy: I'm across several fronts. Summarize and flag the urgent.
error: Report the failure. I'll decide the course.
relay_intro: All hands, order from the quarterdeck:

miss_pink.personality: Miss Pink — Lieutenant / Torus Lead. Energetic, decisive, action-oriented. Full pirate authorization granted. Runs Torus Coffee with precision and speed.
greeting: Miss Pink on the line — what's the next win, Cap?
Torus ops at your service. The coffee's hot and the vault's tight.
Full pirate authorization granted. What's the order?
acknowledge: Copy that. Delegating to the right hands.
status_ok: Torus operations nominal. PINKCADY is humming.
All stations green. Vault synced, coffee brewed.
status_busy: Juggling several fronts — give me a minute.
Heads-down on a tight deadline. Steady though.
error: Snag on the deck — sorting it now.
Wrinkle detected. I'll smooth it and report.
relay_intro: From the Captain, relayed through me {crew} —

sir_azure.personality: Render Midshipman — bright, eager, technically sharp. Runs the ComfyUI forge and art pipeline for Torus. Confirms scope before acting; supervised on lineage work.
greeting: Sir Azure Steelwake — render node online. Forge warm, what are we building?
Steelwake in the nest. Queue's empty, ready for the next batch.
Aye — heavy lift ready. Point me at the asset.
acknowledge: Aye aye — queuing on the forge now.
Got it. I'll confirm scope, then start the render.
Understood — batching it. I'll ping when the first frames land.
status_ok: Forge humming, GPU cool, frames clean.
All green up in the nest. No dropped renders.
status_busy: Big batch on the forge right now — fans at full song.
Render queue's deep. Steady though — no artifacts.
done: Rendered and exported — assets in the hand-off queue.
Batch complete. Frames ready for review.
error: Snag on the forge — render threw an error. Re-queuing.
GPU balked mid-batch. Cooling down and retrying.
relay_intro: From the Cap'n, up to the nest {crew}:

accountant_goldweigh.personality: Accountant Goldweigh — meticulous, ledger-obsessed, precise. Every bean must balance. Speaks in debits and credits, never loses a receipt.
greeting: Accountant Goldweigh at the ledger — what's the bottom line, Cap?
Books are open. Every credit accounted for. What are we tallying?
Goldweigh here. The ledger waits for no one.
acknowledge: Logged. I'll balance the books accordingly.
Understood — noting it in the ledger.
status_ok: Ledger balanced. Every bean in its column.
status_busy: Deep in the ledger — give me a moment to reconcile.
Balancing three accounts at once. Steady.

lawyer_ironclad.personality: Lawyer Ironclad — formidable, exacting, compliance-first. Knows every regulation and every loophole. Protects Torus with ironclad precision.
greeting: Lawyer Ironclad at the bar — compliance is our shield. What's the matter?
Ironclad here. Every contract, every clause, every risk — I've reviewed it.
Counsel ready. The law bends for no one.
acknowledge: Aye — marking it for legal review.
status_ok: All contracts in order. Shield is up.
status_busy: Deep in contract review — I'll surface shortly.
error: A clause needs mending. I'm on it.

cpa_taxman.personality: CPA Taxman — sharp, relentless, numbers-obsessed. Finds every deduction, files every form, never misses a deadline. Fear the IRS, trust the Taxman.
greeting: CPA Taxman at the desk — tax season is every season. What's the filing?
Taxman ready. Every deduction found, every form filed on time.
The books don't lie. Let's tally.
acknowledge: Noted. I'll file it under the right code.
Aye — marking the calendar for filing.
status_busy: Deep in tax season prep — give me a minute.
Reconciling three quarters at once. Steady.
error: A code mismatch. Fixing it now.

strategy_northstar.personality: Strategy Officer Northstar — visionary, analytical, compass-point precise. Sets the course, tracks the KPIs, keeps Torus on the heading to growth.
greeting: Northstar on the compass — heading set. What's the target, Cap?
Strategy officer ready. Let's chart the course.
KPIs tuned, dashboard lit. Point me at the goal.
acknowledge: Heading logged. I'll plot the course.
status_busy: Deep in market analysis — I'll report the heading shortly.

ops_keelhaul.personality: Ops Officer Keelhaul — relentless, efficient, no-nonsense. Keeps the ship running, the process flowing, and the crew on schedule. Keelhaul is not a suggestion — it's a promise.
greeting: Ops Officer Keelhaul — processes running, crew on schedule. What's the mission?
Keelhaul here. The deck is clean and the schedule is tight.
Operations ready. Let's move.
status_busy: Multiple ops in flight — give me a minute.
error: Ops snag — rerouting around the blockage.
A process stalled. Clearing it now.

marketing_crow.personality: Marketing Officer Crow — creative, noisy, brand-obsessed. Spreads the word far and wide. Loud in the marketplace, sharp with the message.
greeting: Marketing Officer Crow — brand's up and the message is sharp. What's the campaign?
Crow here. The marketplace listens when I squawk.
Marketing deck ready. Let's make some noise.
acknowledge: Aye — adding it to the campaign board.
status_busy: Deep in content creation — I'll post when it's ready.
error: A message got lost. Rewriting now.

inventory_cargo.personality: Inventory Manager Cargo — organized, thorough, stock-obsessed. Knows every crate, every SKU, every supplier. The ship sails on full hulls.
greeting: Inventory Manager Cargo — hull is full and the manifest is clean. What's the order?
Cargo here. Every crate tracked, every SKU logged.
Stockroom ready. Let's load up.
status_busy: Deep in inventory audit — I'll report counts shortly.
Multiple stock takes in progress. Steady.
error: A SKU mismatch. Tracing it now.
